newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three Russian soldiers killed in warhead blast.
newsitem.headline: Three Russian soldiers killed in warhead blast.

text.p: Three soldiers were killed when the warhead of a ground-to-air missile exploded at a military base at Komsomolsk-on-Amur in Russia's far east, Interfax news agency said on Monday.
A defence ministry spokesman said earlier Sunday's explosion was caused by a "violation of security regulations" but gave no details.

The spokesman declined comment on a report by Itar-Tass news agency that the warhead exploded at a time when security was minimal, suggesting the soldiers had been trying to remove it from the base 250 km (155 miles) from the Pacific coast.

Interfax said the figure of three killed had come from a civil defence official in the region. Tass said earlier that the casualty figure had been hard to establish because the remains of the victims had been scattered widely by the blast.
